"GAME DEVELOPMENT PROJECT – DEAD ZONE: SURVIVAL

I want to develop a complete 3D post-apocalyptic zombie survival FPS/RPG game inspired by the gameplay concept of The Walking Zombie 2.

The game must have its own original identity, characters, story, locations, weapons, enemies, and visual assets. Do not copy copyrighted content from existing games.

1. GAME CONCEPT

Create a first-person zombie survival shooter with RPG progression.

The world has been destroyed by a mysterious virus. Cities are abandoned, survivors live in small settlements, dangerous mutants roam the streets, and resources are extremely limited.

The player must explore dangerous locations, complete missions, fight zombies, collect resources, upgrade weapons, interact with survivors, and uncover the truth behind the outbreak.

Visual style:

- Stylized low-poly 3D graphics.
- Post-apocalyptic atmosphere.
- Detailed environments with optimized geometry.
- Atmospheric lighting and fog.
- First-person camera.
- Smooth FPS animations.

2. GAMEPLAY SYSTEM

Implement:

- First-person movement.
- Sprinting, jumping, crouching.
- Shooting and reloading.
- Weapon recoil and aiming.
- Health and stamina systems.
- Inventory and equipment.
- Loot collection.
- Zombie combat.
- Mission-based progression.
- NPC interactions.
- Dialogue choices.
- Trading system.
- Weapon upgrades.
- Crafting system.
- Experience and leveling.

All gameplay systems must work together.

3. WEAPONS

Create multiple weapon categories:

- Pistols
- Revolvers
- Shotguns
- Assault rifles
- Sniper rifles
- Submachine guns
- Melee weapons
- Explosives

Each weapon must have:

- Damage
- Fire rate
- Magazine capacity
- Reload time
- Recoil
- Accuracy
- Upgrade levels
- Unique shooting sound
- Reload animation

Implement weapon switching, ammunition management, and weapon customization.

4. ZOMBIE ENEMIES

Create different enemy types:

1. Walker Zombie – Slow basic enemy.
2. Runner Zombie – Fast attacking enemy.
3. Tank Zombie – High health and heavy damage.
4. Screamer – Attracts nearby zombies.
5. Toxic Zombie – Releases poisonous gas.
6. Armored Mutant – Heavy boss enemy.
7. Special Bosses – Unique attack patterns and abilities.

Zombie AI must support:

- Patrolling
- Detecting the player
- Chasing
- Attacking
- Receiving damage
- Death animations
- Searching for the player
- Returning to patrol

5. OPEN WORLD AND LOCATIONS

Create interconnected explorable areas:

- Abandoned City
- Forest Settlement
- Military Base
- Underground Laboratory
- Desert Outpost
- Industrial Zone
- Abandoned Hospital

Every location must have unique environmental storytelling, enemies, loot, missions, and secrets.

6. MISSIONS AND STORY

Create a main story campaign with at least 20 missions.

Mission types:

- Eliminate zombies.
- Rescue survivors.
- Collect supplies.
- Defend settlements.
- Search abandoned buildings.
- Find missing people.
- Investigate laboratories.
- Defeat boss mutants.

Add side missions and NPC dialogue.

Player choices should affect certain story outcomes and relationships with survivors.

7. RPG PROGRESSION

Implement:

- Player levels.
- Experience points.
- Skill tree.
- Character attributes.
- Weapon proficiency.
- Health upgrades.
- Stamina upgrades.
- Damage upgrades.
- Survival abilities.

8. INVENTORY AND ECONOMY

Create a functional inventory system.

Items:

- Ammunition
- Medical kits
- Food
- Water
- Crafting materials
- Weapons
- Armor
- Quest items

Add:

- Item rarity.
- Item descriptions.
- Stackable resources.
- Buying and selling.
- NPC merchants.
- Crafting recipes.

9. PLAYER SAFE ZONE

Create a survivor settlement where players can:

- Talk to NPCs.
- Accept missions.
- Purchase weapons.
- Sell collected resources.
- Upgrade equipment.
- Craft items.
- Rest and restore health.
- Access storage.

10. BOSS BATTLES

Create unique boss encounters with:

- Large health bars.
- Multiple attack patterns.
- Weak points.
- Special abilities.
- Unique rewards.
- Boss introducti (2D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
